biotools.summary: HiCool provides an R interface to process and normalize Hi-C paired-end fastq reads into .(m)cool files. .(m)cool is a compact, indexed HDF5 file format specifically tailored for efficiently storing HiC-based data. On top of processing fastq reads, HiCool provides a convenient reporting function to generate shareable reports summarizing Hi-C experiments and including quality controls.
